interpretation: Only variation confined to the token-embedding gradient is eligible for this criterion. Its numerical bounds are the unchanged full-model whole-parameter bounds. Any variation in attention or other model gradients remains a failure requiring investigation. Preserve and report the original whole-gradient hash inequality.
